title: Conductor Orchestration State
description: Schema for validating conductor-state.json workflow state files

project_name.description: Name of the project being orchestrated

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last state update

tier_score.description: Weighted score from 5-signal classification matrix (scope, type, risk, ambiguity, intent_sensitivity)

tier_override.description: Whether user has manually overridden the tier

tier_signals.description: Individual signal scores used for tier classification

intent_sensitivity.description: How closely this task touches stated intent objectives or hard limits

tier_reclassified.description: Whether tier was reclassified during workflow execution

trigger.description: What caused reclassification (e.g., post-brownfield, post-BRD, post-architect, post-CISO, mid-implementation)

tier_reclassification_history.description: History of tier reclassifications during this workflow

gate_mode.description: Default gate mode for critic checkpoints based on tier

failed_tasks.description: Dead letter queue for tasks that exceeded retry limits

checkpoints.description: History of checkpoints created during orchestration

brd_tracker_hash.description: MD5 hash of BRD-tracker.json at checkpoint time

agents_invoked.description: List of all agents invoked in this workflow

gemini_validations.description: Gemini validation results for every agent dispatch — full accountability audit trail

agent_validated.description: Name of the agent whose output was validated

attempt_number.description: Which attempt this is (1 = first try, 2 = re-dispatch after failure)

phase.description: Conductor phase during which validation occurred

step.description: Conductor step during which validation occurred

raw_response_length.description: Character count of Gemini's raw response

action_taken.description: What the conductor did based on this verdict

mode.description: Whether this was a full validation or targeted re-validation of specific findings

dispatch_mode.description: Hermes E3 (REQ-CDV-HERMES-012): dispatch transport used for this agent invocation. 'task' is the Task tool (default agent loop); 'code-mode' is mcp__MCP_DOCKER__code-mode (programmatic JS over MCP). Flat sibling — NOT nested under .entry. Critic's Code-Mode Constraint Envelope Evidence subsection reads this field.

resolution_applied.description: What Claude's remediation agent changed to fix this

gemini_validation_stats.description: Aggregate stats for Gemini validations across the workflow

ku_ki_extraction.description: KU/KI keyword extraction state from retrospective. Mined from gemini_validations[] to identify phrases correlated with PASS (Key-Useful) vs FAIL/PARTIAL (Key-Irrelevant) verdicts. Production only — downstream consumption by other agents is out of scope.

last_extracted_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent extraction run

extraction_file.description: Path to docs/ku-ki-{project}.yaml relative to project root

validations_window.description: Number of gemini_validations[] entries analyzed in the most recent run

ku_count.description: Count of Key-Useful phrases identified in the most recent run

ki_count.description: Count of Key-Irrelevant phrases identified in the most recent run

min_confidence_threshold.description: Minimum correlation threshold for KU classification (P(PASS | phrase present))

cold_start.description: True when fewer than 10 gemini_validations were available; extraction file is empty with explanatory note

project_signature.description: Per-project style signature accumulated across workflows. Captures behavioral style (conservative, exploratory, ambiguity_tolerance), a rolling Gemini reliability index, and a workflow counter. Optional; absence treated as populated=false (cold-start, no tier bias applied).

populated.description: False until first retrospective populates it. When false, the orchestrator skips style-modifier application.

behavioral_tags.description: Auto-derived style tags from completed workflow outcomes. Limited to the three dimensions specified by the user. Overridden by manual_tags when present.

manual_tags.description: Operator-provided tags. When non-empty, takes precedence over behavioral_tags and is NOT overwritten by retrospective auto-derivation.

reliability_index.description: Rolling Gemini PASS rate over the most recent validations (window size from reliability_window_size). Null until total validations meets the minimum (default 10).

reliability_window_size.description: Number of most-recent gemini_validations[] entries used to compute reliability_index

workflow_count.description: Number of workflows that have contributed to this signature via retrospective Step 11

first_populated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when populated first transitioned to true

last_updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent signature update

sbr_state.description: Subclass Brain Registry (SBR) ingestion state. Tracks how this workflow's PASSed gemini_validations have been indexed into the standalone Qdrant 'sbr' collection. Optional; absence indicates SBR has never been run against this workflow. The SBR collection is owned by the sbr skill and is independent of the claude-memory-plugin long_term collection.

enabled.description: Whether SBR ingestion is enabled for this workflow. When false, scripts/ingest-sbr.sh exits early without contacting Qdrant.

collection_url.description: Qdrant HTTP endpoint for the sbr collection. Direct HTTP — not routed through claude-memory MCP tools (memory_store does not accept a collection parameter).

embedding_model.description: Ollama embedding model used to vectorize prompt-spec pairs. Must produce 768-dim vectors to match the sbr collection schema. Held constant to keep stored points searchable.

last_ingested_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent successful ingestion run against this workflow's state

points_ingested.description: Cumulative count of SBR points successfully upserted from this workflow

points_skipped_dedup.description: Cumulative count of candidate points skipped because their content-hash ID already existed in the sbr collection (idempotent re-ingestion)

points_skipped_sanitization.description: Cumulative count of candidate points skipped because sanitization detected disqualifying content (secrets, restricted-classification markers, etc.)

last_run_status.description: Outcome of the most recent ingest-sbr.sh run

last_run_message.description: Human-readable detail for the last run (e.g., error text or summary line)

post_pentest.description: Always blocking when activated (STANDARD+ tiers only)

pre_release.description: Always blocking when activated (STANDARD+ tiers only)

completeness_validation.description: Completeness validation result — Phase 7 final gate

completeness_report_path.description: Relative path to the completeness report file. Includes timestamp in filename (e.g., completeness-report-20260314T153000Z.json) so multiple runs don't overwrite each other.

advisory_findings.description: Accumulated advisory findings from non-blocking critic gates

project_characteristics.description: Detected project characteristics for agent capability enforcement

crypto_implementations.description: Cryptographic implementations found (e.g., SHA-256, RSA-2048, AES-256-GCM)

agent_instances.description: Non-Human Identity registry — unique instance ID per agent invocation for full traceability

parent_nhi_id.description: NHI ID of agent that spawned this one

constraint_envelope_hash.description: SHA256 hash of the constraint envelope injected at dispatch

hard_limits_count.description: Number of hard limits in the injected constraint envelope

prohibited_behaviors_count.description: Number of prohibited behaviors in the injected constraint envelope

audit_sink.description: External audit trail configuration — ensures logs survive agent compromise

syslog_target.description: Destination. For file: absolute path (e.g. /var/log/conductor/audit.jsonl). For syslog-*: host:port. For http: URL.

transport.description: Transport for audit emission. RECOMMENDED: file (with Wazuh agent tailing it via <localfile log_format=json>) for production. syslog-udp for direct send when no local Wazuh agent. http for SaaS/webhook receivers.

hmac_secret_env.description: Env var name holding HMAC-SHA256 secret for HTTP transport signing

secrets_policy.description: Credential management policy — enforces vault-only architecture

cost_tracking.description: Token and cost tracking for denial-of-wallet protection

intent.description: Intent engineering layer - defines what to optimize for when competing priorities collide. Populated during BRD extraction or project setup. Hard limits may be inherited from CLAUDE.md.

objectives.description: Ranked list of project objectives with measurable signals

goal.description: Clear statement of what to optimize for

signals.description: Observable metrics that indicate progress toward this objective

priority.description: Priority rank (1 = highest). Used for conflict resolution between objectives.

constraints.description: Hard constraints that apply when pursuing this objective

trade_offs.description: Explicit rules for resolving competing priorities

dimension_a.description: First competing dimension (e.g., speed, security, thoroughness)

resolution.description: How to resolve when these dimensions conflict (conditional preferred)

fallback.description: Default resolution when resolution condition is not met

delegation_boundaries.description: Classification of tasks by required human involvement level

autonomous.description: Tasks agents may execute without human confirmation

human_in_loop.description: Tasks requiring human confirmation before agent execution

human_only.description: Tasks that must NOT be executed by agents - human-only

hard_limits.description: Inviolable constraints. Any task touching a hard limit auto-escalates tier. Superset of CLAUDE.md rules + project-specific additions.

prohibited_behaviors.description: Behaviors triggering immediate kill switch. Checked by PostToolUse hook.

recovery_history.description: Recent recovery events for this workflow

recovery_rate.description: Ratio of successful recoveries to total recovery attempts

context_efficiency.description: Ratio of useful output tokens to total input tokens consumed

routing_log.description: History of model routing decisions made by the prediction engine

circuit_breaker.description: Circuit breaker state for external integrations

governance.description: Governance framework state for this conductor session

agent_card_validations.description: Optional audit log of agent card validation outcomes recorded by conductor-agent-gateway. Each entry captures the result of validating a single external invocation against the called agent's card. Backward compatible: existing state files without this field remain valid.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the validation occurred.

agent.description: agent_id that was the target of the external invocation.

caller.description: Caller system identifier as resolved from the authentication method (e.g., conductor, telegram-bridge, n8n, c2).

result.description: Outcome of the card check. validated=both checks passed; missing=no card found for the agent; caller_denied=caller not in allowed_callers; classification_denied=request classification exceeded card clearance.

transition_window.description: True if this validation outcome occurred during the 30-day card_missing soft-fail transition window. False otherwise. For non-missing outcomes this field should be false.

change_log.description: Hermes E6 — per-tool-call attribution log metadata (REQ-CDV-HERMES-001/002)

entries_count.description: Total entries appended to active log this workflow

code_mode_latency.description: Hermes E3 (REQ-CDV-HERMES-015): paired latency measurements between task-mode baseline and code-mode actual runs for the same fan-out template. Top-level sibling to gemini_validations and change_log. Additive — backward compatible. Moved from properties.metrics.properties.code_mode_latency to top-level per Gemini E3 validation 2026-05-20.

task_mode_baseline_ms.description: Latency of the same fan-out via task mode.

code_mode_actual_ms.description: Latency of the same fan-out via code-mode.

skill_promotion.description: Hermes E1 — skill promotion candidates and history (REQ-CDV-HERMES-009/010/011). OPTIONAL block. Mirror of the kernel v3.0 schema fragment so dev v2.0 state files can record promotion lifecycle without schema upgrade. Recorded by the retrospective agent's Section 4 mining and updated by skill-promote.sh / skill-promote-patch.sh on operator action.

candidates.description: Trajectory-pattern promotion candidates surfaced for operator review.

trajectory_ids.description: Qdrant trajectory IDs that contributed to this candidate (>=3 per the §3.6 hard limit).

proposed_skill_path.description: Filesystem path of the drafted SKILL.md under ~/.claude/skills/_proposed/<slug>/

success_count.description: Number of outcome.success trajectories matching the pattern in the 90-day window.

trajectory_pattern_hash.description: SHA-256 of the pipe-joined execution_trace[].tool sequence.

patches.description: Skill self-improvement patch candidates surfaced from change-log re-edit analysis.

target_skill.description: Slug of the skill the patch targets (matches ~/.claude/skills/<slug>/).

patch_path.description: Filesystem path of the unified diff under ~/.claude/skills/_patches/

re_edit_clusters.description: Number of <5min edit clusters detected in the 90-day window.
